title: Execution Stage Ledger Row v0.1
description: One row of the append-only, hash-chained execution stage ledger (Thomas 2026-09-30, docs/proposals/EXECUTION_STAGE_ANTI_ROLLBACK_V0.1.md). The ledger's tip record IS the machine's stage; execution_stage.json is a mirror no decision reads. Each row carries one stage record (validated separately against execution_stage.v0.1), its position in the chain and the hash of the row before it. A chain that does not verify, or that its anchor does not vouch for, reads as READ_ONLY.
